sources.quote: Friedrich Nietzsche (1844–1900) was a German philosopher and cultural critic
Nietzsche was born on October 15, 1844, in Röcken
He lived on until 1900, when he died of a stroke
who published intensively in the 1870s and 1880s
he launches the famous, aggressive and paradoxical pronouncement that “God is dead” (GS 108, 125, 343)

claims.text: summary: truy vấn nguồn gốc và giá trị của đạo đức

sources.quote: He is famous for uncompromising criticisms of traditional European morality and religion
The most extensive development of this Nietzschean critique of morality appears in his late work On the Genealogy of Morality

claims.text: summary: tìm cách khẳng định cuộc đời khi những chỗ dựa cũ sụp đổ

sources.quote: “Nietzsche regards the affirmation of life as his defining philosophical achievement”
With the death of God and the loss of moral absolutes

claims.text: influence: heidegger (nietzsche ảnh hưởng tới heidegger)

sources.quote: Heidegger lectured extensively on Friedrich Nietzsche and the poet Friedrich Hölderlin

It is in Nietzsche’s thought of the will to power and the eternal recurrence of the same, however, that Heidegger thinks we can most clearly discern the key ontological features of the technological age

claims.text: influence: sartre (nietzsche ảnh hưởng tới sartre)

sources.quote: the most popular voices of this movement were French, most notably Jean-Paul Sartre and Simone de Beauvoir
the conceptual groundwork of the movement was laid much earlier in the nineteenth century by pioneers like Søren Kierkegaard and Friedrich Nietzsche

notes: Cạnh Nietzsche → Sartre chỉ có căn cứ gián tiếp: SEP existentialism nói Nietzsche đặt nền khái niệm cho phong trào hiện sinh mà Sartre là tiếng nói tiêu biểu; mục SEP sartre (fall2026) không nhắc Nietzsche. Chấp nhận như một cạnh diễn giải ở mức phong trào.
